intro: Adds safe, lightweight fun commands to every connected platform through the existing chat intakes. Commands register automatically after restart.

sections.title: 1. Start here
sections.notice: Import and approve Fetch Fun Content only when online providers are enabled. All viewer commands arrive through the existing Twitch, YouTube, Kick, and TikTok chat intakes.

sections.title: 2. Facts and jokes
sections.notice: Every provider-backed command has a built-in offline library. Sloth facts are always local because no dependable dedicated provider is required.

sections.title: 3. 8-Ball and hugs
sections.notice: These commands never contact an outside service. Hugs are stored in bounded private add-on state.

sections.title: 4. Time and local utilities
sections.notice: Timezone, dice, choices, ratings, and colors run locally and reply only on the platform that invoked them. Use a standard IANA timezone name; invalid values safely fall back to America/Chicago.

sections.title: 5. Twitch utility
sections.notice: !followage checks only the invoking Twitch viewer through the official Twitch API. Import and approve Twitch Follow Age, keep it triggerless, and ensure the Streamer.bot broadcaster account has follower-read permission.

sections.title: 6. Optional commands
sections.notice: These start disabled. Aesthetic rejects links, control characters, and oversized text so it cannot act as an easy formatting bypass.

sections.title: 7. Spam and repeat protection
sections.notice: The shared cooldown limits total bot replies. The viewer cooldown prevents one account from repeatedly calling commands.

sections.title: 8. Add your own fallback entries
sections.notice: Optional: enter one original or properly licensed item per row. Built-in content remains available and entries are shuffled without immediate repeats.
